items.flavor: Harder hits, so the company's robots fold faster.
More shots every second. My trigger finger files no complaints.
Mag swaps faster than corporate can say overtime.
More lucky hits. I call it skill; the odds disagree.
When a crit lands, it lands like a rockslide.
Bigger mag, fewer reloads, more time making robots regret.
Extra hull plating for me, welded on cheap.
Run faster. Walking away from robots is overrated.
Ore jumps into my pockets from farther away.
Levels come quicker; the company trains me for free.
Drill bites faster, ore leaves before corporate shows up.
Luck bends the card odds my way, as usual.
Shots punch through robots, like Die Hardly but cleaner.
